tracking numbers, I will need to first confirm which filing the replacement should apply to. For instance, form # HA-300 DC is
associated with the following SERFF tracking numbers:
TRVA-125894502
TRVA-128669478
TRVA-128306682
TRVD-133301192
TRVD-131828456
Does this replacement form apply to all of these SERFF tracking numbers? For the rest of the forms, I will need to trace each form
number back to its associated SERFF tracking number. If the form is associated with more than one SERFF tracking number, I will
need to confirm with you which SERFF tracking number the replacement request applies to. Including the previous SERFF tracking
number eliminates these steps so that I can quickly review the filing and submit a disposition. Thank you.
